verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.zoom.us/llms.txt and markdown renderings of the Scribe docs (e.g. /docs/ai-services/scribe/.md). An agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented, machine-readable docs, and the .md doc URLs used throughout the pack reinforce this. Missing for 10: the llms.txt is Zoom-wide rather than Scribe-specific, and the probe does not confirm that Scribe pages are indexed within it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.zoom.us/llms.txt # Zoom Documentation
